#include <iostream>
#include <string>

bool matches(const std::string& s, const std::string& test) {
    int xDigit = -1;
    for (size_t j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
        char sc = s[j];
        char tc = test[j];
        if (sc == 'X') {
            if (xDigit == -1) {
                xDigit = tc;
            } else if (tc != xDigit) {
                return false;
            }
        } else if (sc != '_' && sc != tc) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    int ans = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < 100000000) {
        std::string test = std::to_string(i);
        if (test.length() == s.length() && matches(s, test)) {
            ans++;
        }
        i += 25;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
